# Operator Note — Product Changeover: Hot Forge Line (see SOP-P3-L1-02)

This note summarizes key operator responsibilities and reminders during product changeover on the Hot Forge line. Follow the referenced SOP for full procedure and mandatory safety steps.

Pre-changeover
- Confirm production schedule and tooling assignment with lead planner.
- Verify required dies, punches, and fixturing are staged and tagged for this job.
- Communicate changeover start to upstream and downstream crews to hold incoming materials.

Shutdown and die removal
- Secure the press and confirm energy isolation per SOP before handling tooling.
- Use appropriate lifting devices and follow lift plans when removing heavy components.
- Inspect removed tooling for wear, damage, and foreign material; tag and route for maintenance if needed.

Setup and verification
- Install new tooling using fixtures and torque settings in the tool card.
- Purge and align material feed paths; confirm clamps and guides are adjusted for the new part.
- Perform dry cycles with tooling guards in place to validate cycle motion and part ejection.

Quality and process checks
- Produce trial parts and inspect against dimensional and surface standards.
- Route initial parts to quality for approval before resuming full production.
- Log changeover activities, times, and any deviations in the line changeover record.

Handover
- Update shift log and notify production control when line is stable.
- Return staging area to clean condition and store removed tooling per SOP.
- Report any recurring issues for continuous improvement.
